text: As the City of Toronto experiences unprecedented growth, it is also experiencing significant road safety concerns. In Ward 19, many residents are seeking to curb volume, speed and irreverence of traffic signage on their streets by requesting a traffic review from Transportation Services for calming measures. On behalf of the Roxton Road residents who reside between Bloor Street West and Harbord Street and who are concerned about the safety of the most vulnerable on their street, I kindly request Transportation Services to review and make this segment of Roxton Road safer for all users.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed Transportation Services to conduct a traffic study followed by a poll of Roxton Road between Bloor Street West and Harbord Street on the installation of calming measures to address resident safety concerns regarding speeding and report back to Toronto and East York Community Council.
